definitions.explanation: Lacking in variety or change, resulting in boredom. Describes repetitive situations, routines, or sounds that feel dull due to their uniformity.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{単調|たんちょう}な{生活|せいかつ}を{送|おく}っている。
examples.english: I live a monotonous life every day.

examples.japanese: {単調|たんちょう}な{作業|さぎょう}が{続|つづ}くと{集中力|しゅうちゅうりょく}が{落|お}ちる。
examples.english: When monotonous work continues, concentration drops.

examples.japanese: {景色|けしき}が{変|か}わらない{単調|たんちょう}な{道|みち}を{何時間|なんじかん}も{運転|うんてん}するのは{辛|つら}い。
examples.english: Driving for hours on a monotonous road where the scenery doesn't change is tough.

notes:
Used as a na-adjective ({単調|たんちょう}な～) to describe things that lack variety. Generally carries a negative connotation of boredom and tedium.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{単調|たんちょう}な{生活|せいかつ} — monotonous life
・{単調|たんちょう}な{作業|さぎょう} — monotonous work
・{単調|たんちょう}な{毎日|まいにち} — humdrum days
・{単調|たんちょう}なリズム — monotonous rhythm
